title: ConsentChanged
description: FR-14: consent of a contact for one channel changed. Mirrors a row appended to contacts.consents; the current value also lives in field 31 (email), 32 (sms) or 33 (push). contact_id is required.

source.description: Where the change came from, e.g. api, import, form, unsubscribe, admin.

text.description: Consent text the contact accepted, or null when there is none (e.g. unsubscribe link).
